why: OCR-to-harmony promotion produced no improvement: melody error remains 66.9% and chord error 78.9%. Direct pixel transcription tests whether a different recognition approach can recover both missing chords and incorrect notes on the same seven excerpts, using seven model calls.
hypothesis: Vision transcription will reduce both melody and chord sequence error relative to enlarged Audiveris by reading notation and chord symbols directly into editable kern.
expected_observation: Independent evaluation should show melody error below 66.9% and chord error below 78.9%. Equal or higher error in either metric would contradict the joint-improvement hypothesis. Parse failures and transposition checks must also be inspected; this pilot cannot establish full-goal completion or audited chord timing.
